# CineRename

> The ultimate tool to rename and organize your movies and TV shows for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby.

## About CineRename
CineRename is a blazing fast desktop application that automatically renames, cleans up, and organizes your media library using TheTVDB metadata. It ensures perfect compatibility with modern media servers.

## Key Features
- Drag & Drop Interface
- Automatic and Manual modes
- TheTVDB Integration
- Blazing fast performance (built with Tauri and Rust)
- Audio/Video Sync verification
- Dry-run reports
